changeinfo.changes:
02/22/2012

Update Information

・Visual Lobbies are now open
"Plaza Lobby 1"
"Elite Lounge 1"

・Real Tournaments have begun.

・Power-saving feature changed.

The game will no longer enter Standby Mode due to lack of input in the following cases:

While in a Visual Lobby
During a Real Tournament
During movie playback

・Caddy Select feature changed.

07/23/2012

Update Information

・Daily International Tours have started.
・Tours will be held every Tuesday to Sunday, the results announced on Monday.
・One tournament held per day.
・Tournament History feature added (Changed from "Tournaments Entered").
・Career Stats feature added.

・Additional lobby character parts.

・A Grading System has begun in Real Tournament.
・Additional "Item Chance" based on Grade results.
・Additional Lobby character actions by Grade

・A Trajectory Display function is now available during a Real Tournament round.

・A Multiplayer Room is now available in:
・New Real Mode
・Stroke
・Match Play

・Moved Shot Point Ranking to Main Menu

・Error fixed in Real Tournament Score.
・Error fixed in video playback.
・Other changes and corrections.

02/28/2013

Update Information

・Turn-Based Challenge Mode is now available
・4-player Stroke Mode multiplayer rooms are now available.
・Game balance adjustments.
・A new visual lobby is now open.
"Elite Lounge 2"
・Additional items are available.
・Adjustments to item acquisition method.
・Real Tournament award specifications changed.
・Daily Int'l Tournament specifications changed.
・Other changes and fixes.

07/16/2013

Update Information

・Cross Play compatible
・"Slot Mode" is available
・Commemorative items are available
・Additional items are available
・New rules,"HSG Rules", are added
・Enhanced start menu
・Game balance adjustment
・Others, changes and modifications

Update Information

・Adjustments made to real tournaments and daily tournaments.

[Other]

・Bugs fixed.
・Implemented Information function.
